confidence.label: High confidence
confidence.advice: Early trend -- the best conditions for every grade. A+ to B.

rules.entry: Buy-stop at the 20-day highest close. Fills only if the stock opens below it and trades up into it; if it gaps above, no trade.
rules.exit: Trail the stop at close - 4x ADR once that is above your entry (so it never goes back below breakeven). 4x is the default; the app can show 2x / 6x / 8x.
rules.grade: A+ = 3+ points, A = 2, B = 1, C = 0, D = -1, F = -2 or less (see Setup Grades).
